capabilities.title: Attack phases (wind-up, active, recovery)
capabilities.notes: Engine-free rules: an attack has wind-up, active and recovery; a contact lands only in the active window, once per target per swing. Phases from seconds or from clip marks.

capabilities.title: Weapon hitboxes and body hurtboxes
capabilities.notes: Contact decides the hit: Hitbox on the weapon, Hurtbox on the body, reported to the rules.

capabilities.title: Sweep arcs (contact without physics)
capabilities.notes: An attack's arcs around the attacker, timed over the active window; enemies can land blows by them.

capabilities.title: Hit reactions, poise and hit tiers
capabilities.notes: Poise, hyper armour on uninterruptible attacks, light/heavy/knockdown tiers by the attack's Stagger, each with its own time and knockback.

capabilities.title: Dodge with invulnerability frames
capabilities.notes: Dodge with i-frames for its whole time or a window inside it.

capabilities.title: Held block with a cost
capabilities.notes: A held block covers a cone in front; each blow costs from a stock and the guard breaks when it cannot pay.

capabilities.title: Parry and perfect block
capabilities.notes: A parry window, then recovery; a frontal blow in the window is parried and a melee attacker is opened. A blow in the recovery is a failed parry. Optional perfect block on block raise; unparryable attacks. Enemies do not parry (combat.enemy_parry).

capabilities.title: Enemies that parry
capabilities.notes: Parry works for the player and for the game's own AI; the built-in enemy behaviour only blocks and dodges.

capabilities.title: Stamina cost of attacks
capabilities.notes: An attack or charge pays its cost from an attack stock when it starts; one that cannot pay is refused. The stamina policy lives in the game's stock.

capabilities.title: Motion warping
capabilities.notes: Pulls the attacker to the target and turns it to face it during part of a phase, within distance and angle limits.

capabilities.title: Moves inside attacks (approach, retreat, strafe, leap)
capabilities.notes: Distances over part of a phase, including a leap with a height; the enemy director moves its bodies by them.

capabilities.title: Hold-to-charge and quick attack
capabilities.notes: The hold is clamped to min/max and damage follows a curve; a short release is the quick attack.

capabilities.title: Held wind-up
capabilities.notes: A wind-up waits at its hold point (the clip stands too) until released.

capabilities.title: Attack speed
capabilities.notes: Per-combatant attack speed scales the phases; the animation pace follows.

capabilities.title: Combos
capabilities.notes: Enemy combos: move links that continue only while they land, kept per weapon kind. A player combo chain (input buffer, cancel windows) is built by the game from single attacks.

capabilities.title: Projectiles without physics
capabilities.notes: Straight flights ticked with the fight: Landing (arc, area at the landing point) or Contact (first body, optional pierce); exact lead for moving targets.

capabilities.title: Combat timeline (diagnostics)
capabilities.notes: Records phases, contacts, damage, dodges, blocks, refusals and AI decisions with exact times. Not analytics.

capabilities.title: Combat analytics
capabilities.notes: Counts per attack and in total: uses, hit, miss and interrupt rates, damage, the distance enemies chose it from; failed approaches (an attack token given up without an attack); enemy chains ranked best and worst. Each finished swing is an outcome for telemetry (combat_hit, combat_miss... through Integration.ActionCombatTelemetry).

capabilities.title: Animator bridges
capabilities.notes: Drive Animator parameters from combat and enemy state (hits by tier, parry, opened, death).

capabilities.title: Damage, resistances and life state
capabilities.notes: Damage calculation by type, element resistances, health and other resources, death and resurrection.

capabilities.title: Perception (sight, hearing, memory)
capabilities.notes: Sight radius, view cone, line of sight, hearing and being struck; remembers a lost target; Notice state.

capabilities.title: Patrol, chase, circle, back off, leash
capabilities.notes: Movement states with turn limits; enemies keep apart; a leash returns them home. Steering is straight with separation (see ai.pathfinding_steering).

capabilities.title: Attack tokens (N attackers per target)
capabilities.notes: At most N enemies attack a target at once; the others circle.

capabilities.title: Weighted moves with ranges and cooldowns
capabilities.notes: Moves chosen by range, weight and cooldown; commit range so blows land (0.36.0); held swings; gap closers; a move may need the enemy to face its target first (MaxAngle).

capabilities.title: Answers what the target does
capabilities.notes: Move weights by the target's state (e.g. a heavy blow against Blocking); other block/dodge chances against a pressing target; repositioning after an attack. Fixed rules, not learning.

capabilities.title: Adaptive enemy AI (learns the player)
capabilities.notes: An enemy remembers its target's last N actions (dodge side, block, parry, retreat, pressing) and chooses the moves that answer a habit more often, as far as it has learnt it (learning 0..1 per kind of monster; 0 = a zombie). The memory is per target and forgotten when the target is lost.

capabilities.title: Enemy block and dodge chances, punish pause
capabilities.notes: Chances to block or dodge a swing, a punish window after an attack, backing off when hurt.

capabilities.title: Unity enemy body
capabilities.notes: Moves the body along the director's intent, applies knockback and leaps.

capabilities.title: Behaviour tree
capabilities.notes: Generic tree with selector, sequence, inverter, repeater and a blackboard; tested, but no game has shipped on it.

capabilities.title: Enemy pathfinding around obstacles
capabilities.notes: Enemies steer straight with separation; the director has no pathfinding hook.

capabilities.title: Stats with modifiers
capabilities.notes: Named stats with flat and percent modifiers by source.

capabilities.title: Character stats in the action RPG kit
capabilities.notes: Crits, evasion, life steal, elements and resistances on characters, gear, effects and skills.

capabilities.title: Attribute point allocation
capabilities.notes: No attribute-point spending: the game adds StatContainer modifiers. Skill points exist (skills.trees).

capabilities.title: Experience and levels
capabilities.notes: Experience, level tables and curves, level-up events, stat growth, unlocks.

capabilities.title: Shared or per-player progress in co-op
capabilities.notes: Party progress or each player's own.

capabilities.title: Enemy levels and elites
capabilities.notes: Enemy levels and elite variants in the action RPG kit.

capabilities.title: Skill trees with prerequisites
capabilities.notes: Trees, prerequisites, skill points, bonuses; wired into both kits.

capabilities.title: Abilities: costs, cooldowns, casts, channels, charges, toggles
capabilities.notes: Resource cost and upkeep, cooldowns, cast and channel, charges, toggles, passives; delayed and repeated impacts (0.34.0). Area by radius is chosen by the game's effect callback.

capabilities.title: Buffs, debuffs, damage over time
capabilities.notes: Effects with duration, ticks, stacking and stat modifiers; events on apply, tick, expire.

capabilities.title: Items and registry
capabilities.notes: Item definitions, instances, quality, rarity, consumables.

capabilities.title: Random affixes, rarity and sets
capabilities.notes: Affix pools, rarity tables with luck, rolled items, item sets with bonuses.

capabilities.title: Inventory containers
capabilities.notes: Containers with capacity and stacks; a party backpack or one per player.

capabilities.title: Equipment slots and gear
capabilities.notes: Equipment slots; kit gear with affixes and sets. The UI equipment panel is a thin default.

capabilities.title: Loot tables
capabilities.notes: Weighted tables, no duplicates, drop events.

capabilities.title: Crafting
capabilities.notes: Recipes, stations, tools, requirements.

capabilities.title: Shops and currencies
capabilities.notes: Offers per player, wallets, all-or-nothing item transfer, player pricing, refusal codes.

capabilities.title: Factions and reputation
capabilities.notes: Factions, relations, reputation with spreading; kit hostility and faction traders.

capabilities.title: Quests, objectives, rewards
capabilities.notes: Objectives (kill, collect, explore, interact...), rewards, registry, accept/complete/fail events.

capabilities.title: Stages with branches
capabilities.notes: Stages with their own objectives, transitions signalled by the game, success or failure outcomes.

capabilities.title: Requirements, repeat cooldowns, refusals
capabilities.notes: Level, faction, item and flag requirements; cooldown for repeatable quests; why a quest is refused.

capabilities.title: Quest graph validation
capabilities.notes: Checks a quest's stage graph for problems (no visual editor).

capabilities.title: Branching dialogue
capabilities.notes: Nodes, choices, conditions (incl. the game's own), events; a line with no next ends the conversation.

capabilities.title: Dialogue type, quest link, participants, localization keys
capabilities.notes: Quest and stage link, participants, a localization key per line.

capabilities.title: Barks
capabilities.notes: Ambient one-liners picked by the rules.

capabilities.title: Dialogue effects in the kit
capabilities.notes: Choices that give items, start quests, change reputation, raise events.

capabilities.title: Dialogue graph validation
capabilities.notes: Checks a dialogue graph for problems (no visual editor).

capabilities.title: Quest and dialogue import (rpgframework.content/1)
capabilities.notes: Imports quests and dialogues from JSON format rpgframework.content/1, into the kit or as assets, with problems reported.

capabilities.title: Project index
capabilities.notes: Read-only JSON map of the project: assets with GUIDs and references, scenes, prefabs, scripts, framework modules used.

capabilities.title: Interaction points
capabilities.notes: Points with an outcome and an event; the distance policy is the game's.

capabilities.title: Grid A*
capabilities.notes: A* over a grid navigation graph.

capabilities.title: Distance map / flow field
capabilities.notes: One map serves many chasers.

capabilities.title: Save slots with versioned sections
capabilities.notes: Slots, versioned sections with upgrade, backup copy, unknown sections kept, metadata and summaries.

capabilities.title: Kit saves
capabilities.notes: The action RPG and turn-based kits save their whole state.

capabilities.title: Cloud saves
capabilities.notes: Only the interface; no provider implementation.

capabilities.title: Action RPG co-op, 2-8 players, host-authoritative
capabilities.notes: Host-authoritative co-op for 2-8 players: build and content fingerprint, speed checks, rejoin (seat kept 2 min), sync of positions, hits, effects, progress, gear, interaction.

capabilities.title: PvP matches
capabilities.notes: Rounds, score, respawns, team hostility.

capabilities.title: Lobby before the match
capabilities.notes: Hero choice, ready, kick, start with a countdown.

capabilities.title: LAN play and discovery
capabilities.notes: Unity Transport over UDP; LAN game discovery.

capabilities.title: Internet play via Unity Relay
capabilities.notes: Room code through Unity Relay (needs com.unity.services.multiplayer); proven only against a fake service, not between two real networks.

capabilities.title: Game's own network messages
capabilities.notes: Custom messages with authority; latest-state messages.

capabilities.title: Turn-based online sessions
capabilities.notes: Host-run turn matches for board and card games: lobby, moves checked by rules, per-seat views for hidden cards, prompts, turn clock, rejoin, hot-seat.

capabilities.title: Generic entity replication
capabilities.notes: Older generic replication; the kits do not use it.

capabilities.title: Party battles in turns (JRPG style)
capabilities.notes: Battles with crits, elements, skill trees, quests, reputation and a battle screen built from code. No content assets (filled in code), items only in battle, no auto-battle.

capabilities.title: Action RPG from inspector assets
capabilities.notes: Game Setup and Character assets, host, player controls, HUD, health bars with a damage trail, waves, consumables.

capabilities.title: Companions
capabilities.notes: A Companions module exists (rules, tests) but the action RPG kit has no companions.

capabilities.title: Achievements
capabilities.notes: Criteria and counters, wired into both kits.

capabilities.title: Sound cues, music, volume channels
capabilities.notes: Cues with variants and voice limits, music crossfades, volume channels kept between runs; menu scenes without a game host.

capabilities.title: Telemetry events in batches
capabilities.notes: Events with level, zone, entity, mechanic and quest ids, position and up to 20 properties; build, session, pseudonymous player and context (platform, mode, cohort, A/B variant) added. Batches of up to 500 as { "events": [...] } every 30 s and on pause or session end, sent off the game thread, retried with a growing pause; position samples at most every 5 s; survey answers. The queue lives in memory; HttpClient, so not WebGL.

capabilities.title: Opt-in consent
capabilities.notes: Nothing is kept or sent until the player agrees; withdrawing drops the queue. Kept in PlayerPrefs by the Unity module.

capabilities.title: Sending to the game's collector
capabilities.notes: Posts JSON with a bearer key; or a transport of the game. The Unity module drives it in real time and sends on pause and quit.

capabilities.title: String tables and plurals
capabilities.notes: Per-language tables, named values, plural forms (incl. Ukrainian), CSV for translators.

capabilities.title: Settings page
capabilities.notes: Typed options kept between runs: display, volumes, language.

capabilities.title: Seeded dice with a log
capabilities.notes: Seeded dice, roll log, scripted dice for tests.

capabilities.title: Decks and hands
capabilities.notes: Generic decks, hands and deck assets.

capabilities.title: Time of day, seasons, weather
capabilities.notes: Rules and events, tested; no game has shipped on it.

capabilities.title: Prefab spawning and pooling
capabilities.notes: Prefab catalog and spawner over shared pools.

capabilities.title: Render budget per device class
capabilities.notes: Triangles in view by model, draw calls, set-pass calls, batches against a budget; presets per device class (RenderPlatform from 0.42.0: low-end, mid and high-end phones, standalone VR, WebGL, handhelds, PC, current consoles); Measure() for budget tests. GPU counters in the Editor and development builds only.

capabilities.title: In-game diagnostics panel
capabilities.notes: Systems, events, timers, pools and frame times in an overlay; sections of the game's own. A small see-through panel over the game refreshed every frame (DiagnosticsPanelLayout Compact: frame rate and the render budget in short lines), corner, opacity, fit-to-text size, chosen sections from the version that lists this note.

capabilities.title: Frame time and memory
capabilities.notes: Average and worst FPS, managed memory, garbage collections.

capabilities.title: Debug shapes in the Scene view
capabilities.notes: Circles, spheres, boxes, crosses, arrows.

capabilities.title: Content validation with an exit code
capabilities.notes: Quests, dialogues, factions, recipes, items and loot checked in batch mode (exit 0 clean, 1 errors, 2 the check failed); quest and dialogue graph checks.

capabilities.title: Project index
capabilities.notes: A read-only JSON map of the project: assets with GUIDs and references, scenes, prefabs, scripts, framework modules used.

capabilities.title: Architecture rules for games (GA01-GA15)
capabilities.notes: Tests a game derives to keep its rules engine-free, its services in modules and its code off hand-made framework copies.

capabilities.title: AI guidance for games
capabilities.notes: CLAUDE.md block, recipes, process files and commands installed into a game; a session-start check for newer framework versions (releases.json).

capabilities.title: Designer windows and wizards
capabilities.notes: Framework Manager, item database, item, loot table and quest wizards, loot table editor, create menus for every module asset. No visual graph editors (tools.visual_graph_editors).

capabilities.title: Test doubles
capabilities.notes: Two players on one machine without sockets, sound recorded instead of played, test helpers for characters and UI.

missing.title: Visual graph editors for dialogue, quests, skill trees
Client-side prediction
missing.notes: Not supported: a guest sees its hits one round-trip later.

missing.title: Host migration
missing.notes: Not supported, by design for now.

missing.title: Online matchmaking, Steam and EOS providers
missing.notes: Not supported: LAN and Unity Relay room codes only.

missing.title: 2D physics in the genre kits
missing.notes: The action RPG kit is 3D; a 2D look is a 3D scene with an orthographic top camera.
